title: The Imp Thief
text: An imp darts through camp in a blur of claws and cackling, quicker than a cat. It vanishes into the dark with a House's purse in its teeth. Somewhere out there it is laughing as it counts the coins.

options.label: The quickest gives chase into the dark to get the purse back.

outcomes.text: They catch it by the tail beside its whole stash. It is still cackling as they empty its hoard.
It leads them straight into its nest. It was never really running; its kin were waiting.

options.label: Let it go; chasing an imp into the dark is a fool's errand.

outcomes.text: You are lighter by a purse. Its laughter carries a long way through the night.

options.label: The cleverest baits a trap with more gold and lets greed do the rest.

outcomes.text: Greedy for seconds, it comes back and drops the first purse to snatch the bait. The trap snaps shut on its tail.
